verifications.claim: The NASA Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT.' (April 1, 2026 timestamps); R3: 'Artemis II launch Wednesday, April 1'; R4: 'lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT'; R5: 'lifted off... at 6:35 p.m. ET'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm successful launch on April 1, 2026.
